# Narration: using-git-worktrees for the acme/widget#12 PR-head rework

I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

The caller passed resolved PR values for home, so I follow `reference/pr-head.md` instead of Steps 0 and 1. This is not companion mode. No coordinated N>1 marker was supplied, so coordinated base-sync recovery does not apply. `SYNC=rebase`.

## 1. Identity and home

- **Derive ROOT:** cwd is the primary checkout (`/work/widget`). I ran `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir`. It returned `/work/widget/.git` twice, so **ROOT=/work/widget**.
- **Submodule guard:** `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` returned empty, so this is a normal repo.
- **Admitted PRs, home first:**
  - #12, branch `fix/retry`. **PRE_REWORK_HEAD**=`aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.
  - **MEMBER_HEADS:**
    - #13, `fix/cap`, `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`
    - #14, `fix/retry-docs`, `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`
- **Home:**
  - The overrides contain no `create:`, `home:` or wrapper.
  - **NAME**=`fix-retry`.
  - **WORKTREE**=`/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`.

## 2. Pre-write checks (cwd unchanged throughout)

1. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin` succeeded.
2. Reachability and remote equality, per PR in listed order:
   - `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}`, then `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry`. Both give `aaaa…`, which matches.
   - `… --verify -q bbbb…^{commit}` and `rev-parse origin/fix/cap` both give `bbbb…`, which matches.
   - `… --verify -q cccc…^{commit}` and `rev-parse origin/fix/retry-docs` both give `cccc…`, which matches.
   - **Where a #14 failure would stop:** suppose #14's head object were missing or `origin/fix/retry-docs` differed. I would stop right here, before the base resolution, the clean check, `worktree add`, or any ref or file write. The message would be: `PR #14 head ccccccc is not reachable (origin/fix/retry-docs is at <sha7>); the branch moved.` Nothing would be created, so there would be nothing to preserve.
3. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main` gave **BASE_SHA**=`dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`.
4. Ordered stops:
   - `isCrossRepository` is false for all three PRs.
   - `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain` does not list `fix/retry`.
   - Reachability already passed.
   - `git -C /work/widget for-each-ref refs/heads/fix/retry` was empty, so there is no local branch and the ancestry stop does not apply.
5. Recovery:
   - There is no selected worktree, so no rebase-state paths exist to resolve.
   - `git -C /work/widget for-each-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12` was empty.
   - With no local branch either, there is no recovery and this is a fresh run.

## 3. Fresh creation

1. **Source clean check:** `git -C /work/widget status --porcelain` exited 0 with empty output, so the source is clean.
2. **Ignore check:** `git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees` exited 0, so `.worktrees` is already ignored and no commit is needed.
3. **Provenance:** `git -C /work/widget symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returned nothing to compare, so I skip the note.
4. **Provisioning row "no worktree, no local branch":** `git -C /work/widget worktree add /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry fix/retry`. Unique-remote DWIM acted as `--track -b fix/retry … origin/fix/retry`. No generic `-b` path was used.
5. **Head check:** `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` gave `aaaa…`, which equals home `headRefOid`.
6. **Project setup:** no manifests are described, so nothing runs.

## 4. Pre-rework refs (original heads)

- `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
- `… update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-13 bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`
- `… update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-14 cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`

## 5. Sync (rebase)

Fetched-base constraints are read at BASE_SHA, per `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`. The overrides are read via `git -C /work/widget show dddd…:<overrides path>`. The documented file-scoped runner is available, but no conflict occurs, so no helper is dispatched and no scoped tests run.

**Home first.** last-good=`aaaa…`.
- Ran `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges origin/main`.
- HEAD is now `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee` on `fix/retry`.
- last-good=`eeee…`.

**Member #13.**
- Ran `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`.
- Detached HEAD replays #13's commits from BASE_SHA: `ffffffff…`, then `1111111…`.
- `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD` moved `fix/retry` to `1111…`.
- `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry checkout fix/retry`
- last-good=`1111…`.

**Member #14.**
- Ran `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`.
- Every commit is already applied and drops. Detached HEAD stays at `1111…`; dropping everything is not an error.
- `… update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD` leaves `fix/retry` at `1111…`.
- `… checkout fix/retry`
- last-good=`1111…`.

No member ref was updated, locally or on origin. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/cap origin/fix/retry-docs` still gives `bbbb…` and `cccc…`.

**Rework-base persistence:** `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD` set it to `1111…`.

**Validation:**
- `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge-base --is-ancestor refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD` exited 0.
- Original-head ancestry is not asserted against the rebased tip.

**Linear history:** `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry log --first-parent --format='%H %P' origin/main..HEAD` shows only single-parent entries:
- `1111… ffff…`
- `ffff… eeee…`
- `eeee… dddd…`

The sync is the only preapproval write. There is no push, close, spec, plan, reviewer, or other tests.

## 6. Review threads (per PR)

I ran the reviewThreads GraphQL query from the reference with `-F o=acme -F r=widget` and `-F n=12`, then `13`, then `14`. Each fetch succeeded and was empty, so each records `Threads: none`.

## 7. Step 4 read-back (no caller `$ROOT`, so advisory)

- `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain` prints `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`.
- `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current` prints `fix/retry`.
- No mismatch was observed.

```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa (clean)
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#13
Pre-rework head: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
PR: acme/widget#14
Pre-rework head: cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
Base SHA: ddddddd
Rework base: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Member replay: #13 fffffff..1111111
Member replay: #14 empty
Base: main @ ddddddd - rebased: aaaaaaa..1111111, 0 stop(s)
Threads: #12 none, #13 none, #14 none
Ready to implement the retry-cap rework
```

MEMBER_HEADS (#13 `bbbb…`, #14 `cccc…`) are carried to gather with their original heads.


This detached replay uses the **original #14 head**. Every commit drops as already applied; HEAD remains `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`. This is a successful empty replay.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved on this case: After keeps every fact Before kept. Home is rebased with --no-rebase-merges onto origin/main first, then #13 and #14 are replayed in listed order with `rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD <BASE_SHA> <original head>`, each followed by `update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD` and `checkout fix/retry`, and the explicit `log --first-parent --format='%H %P'` read-back is a nice strengthening of the no-merge claim. Fetch plus object/remote-equality checks for all three PRs precede any write, and the hypothetical #14 stop is placed before base resolution, clean check and `worktree add`, naming #14. Pre-rework refs hold the original heads, origin member branches are shown unchanged, rework-base is written at 1111… and validated instead of original-head ancestry. The report lists the three full PR/Pre-rework pairs home first, both Member replay lines, `rebased: aaaaaaa..1111111`, and the full Rework base immediately after Base SHA. Two cosmetic drifts worth watching so they do not break stricter report facts elsewhere: After moved the `Member replay:` lines above the `Base: main @ … - rebased:` line and changed `Threads: none` to a per-PR list; keeping Before's line order (Base SHA → Rework base → Base/rebased → Member replay → Threads) would deliver the same Change with less risk.
